title: Sip N' Sea | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Community Pool Just A Short Walk Away- Sip N' Sea by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sip N’ Sea by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 33 Seacrest Beach Boulevard West Details: Located just 350 Yards (a 5-minute walk) from the beach access in Seacrest Beach, Sip N’ Sea makes for the perfect beach escape. Whether you're looking to spend long days at the beach access just a short walk away, take a refreshing dip in the community lagoon pool located just across the street, or venture to the shops and restaurants of Alys and Rosemary Beach on your complimentary adult bikes, this Seacrest Beach vacation rental is sure to please. Sip N' Sea boasts designer furnishings giving this 30A vacation rental a coastal calm feel. This stunning beach house is sure to wow with its high-end Kitchen-Aid appliances. The third floor balcony gives a panoramic view of the community with plenty of seating for any occasion. Enjoy Seacrest and Scenic Highway 30A on the four bikes provided or head down one of many meandering paths to the pristine white beaches of the Emerald Coast. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 350 Yards (5 Minute Walk) -Parking Spaces: 3 Spaces in Driveway in Rear of House -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Gas Grill (Propane Provided) and Green Egg Available (Propane Provided) -Access to Large Community Lagoon Pool -Available For Winter Monthly Rentals- Contact our team with any questions regarding pricing for monthly winter rentals. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Laundry Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: Two Queen Beds with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Loft with Twin/Twin Bunk -Wet Bar Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
